elements.description: Bar chart titled 'Dissimilarity index in bundled opportunities'. Y-axis: 'Dissimilarity index', scale 0.00 to 0.30 in steps of 0.05. X-axis categories: '8 out of 11', '9 out of 11', '10 out of 11'. Single series (teal bars); no values printed on the bars. Approximate readings: 8 out of 11 ~0.06; 9 out of 11 ~0.13; 10 out of 11 ~0.25. Note: 'Total of 11 indicators in a bundle, see Annex 4.2. In the bundle, on-time education completion is considered one indicator.' Source: 'World Bank staff calculations using VHLSS 2020.' The dissimilarity index rises as the required number of opportunities in the bundle increases.
